title: Zephyrine and the Witness
author: Ulyana Sandoval
blurb: Dominic Kavanagh, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
